description: Returns a step by step plan for setting up the host's WordPress site: what has to be installed, what to click, what the room needs. It only reads and touches nothing. Take it when a host wants to know what comes next, for example "What do I have to do on my side before the first webinar?" It needs no session, the language is enough. You can say whether the host already has WordPress, already uses WebinarIgnition and already works with a connector, then done steps drop out of the plan. Words hosts use: setup plan, what do I have to do, installed, first webinar

has_mcp.description: true when the host already uses an MCP/connector — the connector normally sets this itself.

has_wi.description: true when WebinarIgnition is already installed on the host's site.

has_wordpress.description: true when the host already has a WordPress site. Reist als Fluss-Signal mit: ohne es gilt der Standardweg (der Host hat vermutlich WordPress). Mit false wird der Verbinden-Schritt in der Strecke uebersprungen.

language.description: The language the host writes in.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

name: wi_get_setup_plan
title: Get the setup plan
